A quiet retreat from a loud world

BodyWorks Massage & Wellness Center is a multi-room practice in Littleton where the focus is simple: help your whole body feel better. Our licensed therapists take the time to understand how you move, where you hold tension, and what you want from the hour.

No rushing, no upselling — just intentional, therapeutic work in a space designed to help you fully exhale.

  • Sessions tailored to your body, every visit
  • Multiple private treatment rooms
  • A clinical-yet-warm, restful environment

Good to Know

Common questions

Do I need an appointment?

Booking ahead is best so we can hold your time and the right therapist for you. You can request a session through the form above, by phone, or with the chat in the corner.

What should I expect on my first visit?

We'll talk through your goals, health history and any problem areas, then tailor the session to you. You're always professionally draped and in control of pressure throughout.

What do I wear?

Undress to your comfort level. You'll be draped with sheets at all times and only the area being worked on is ever uncovered.

Which massage is right for me?

If you're after relaxation, Swedish or hot stone is a great start. For chronic tension, recovery or specific pain, deep tissue or sports recovery is usually the better fit. Not sure? Tell us your goals and we'll guide you.

What's your cancellation policy?

Life happens. Just give us 24 hours' notice and we'll happily reschedule your session.
